summary: Omega Flex, Inc. filed an 8-K to report the results of its Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on June 10, 2026, and to announce a regular quarterly dividend. The filing includes Item 5.07 disclosure of the election of three class 3 directors and Item 8.01 disclosure of a press release declaring a $0.34 per share dividend payable on July 7, 2026. There are no special situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or activist campaigns. This is a routine current report covering ordinary corporate governance and dividend actions.
